restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมเอเชีย
text: I've had braces for 10 years, and my teeth are crooked. Now I'm going to Mahidol Hospital, and every filling I've had done there has been ruined. The hard material used for fillings is damaging my teeth. They've never even used a dental X-ray machine. I had root canal treatment on two teeth, which was very expensive, but both roots rotted, requiring new implants – costing me twice. Even the fillings are blackened because the material is so hard. The dentist is inexperienced; they do everything themselves – fillings, root canals, orthodontics – they handle it all alone. It's unbelievable. There are no words to describe it. They shouldn't even have a clinic; they're ruining patients' dental lives.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมเอเชีย
text: My teeth were braced for seven years and still weren't fixed, so I had no choice but to ask the dentist to remove them. The result was that they were practically ruined by the braces.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมเอเชีย
text: The doctor is experienced and highly skilled. I personally brought my child here for braces. My child's case is not easy. The doctor makes appointments every 3 weeks. Each time the braces are changed, it is quick. Mom parked nearby and waited for my child in the car. Mom also took impressions of the teeth to whiten them at home. I have used their services for many years and am impressed with their expertise. I have been to other places near my workplace and sometimes I am unsure of the diagnosis...so I will come back to consult at this clinic again.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมเอเชีย
text:
1. The doctor gave no advice whatsoever. I paid, the procedure was done, and that was it. There was no mention of any precautions or warnings.
2. The staff lacked accurate information. When I called to inquire about laser wisdom tooth extraction, the employee on the line said no, only scalpel. In the end, I had to have laser surgery.
3. The doctor was extremely heavy-handed. I signaled that I was in a lot of pain several times, both with my hands and by shouting, but they ignored me. They forced my mouth open forcefully, causing my jaw to be sprained for almost a week.

In short, I've used their services since I was a child, but I will never go back again. I'm completely fed up.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมเอเชีย
text: It's a small dental clinic, but the doctor is incredibly skilled and kind. I had orthodontic treatment with Dr. O several years ago, but stopped due to the Covid situation. I plan to go back for further dental work. It's far away in Rayong, but when it comes to dental work, I always trust and feel comfortable with Dr. O.

text: I had my braces done here for several years until it was finished. It cost 2000 baht a month, which was good; I didn't have any problems. However, the doctor doesn't talk much, but you can ask questions if you have any. Even after the braces were finished, I still came back for teeth cleaning once a year.
